column2: This workbook contains the complete vendor database structure for printing estimation.
Paper/substrate pricing by vendor (linked via Vendor_ID)
Printing machine rates by vendor (linked via Vendor_ID)
Post-press operation rates by vendor (linked via Vendor_ID)
Bought-out materials & packing materials (linked via Vendor_ID)
Example entries showing how to fill data
Start by entering vendors in VENDOR_MASTER sheet
For each vendor, add their specific rates in the relevant child table(s)
Use Vendor_ID to link child records to parent vendor

VENDOR DATABASE STRUCTURE: - Vendor_ID must be unique in VENDOR_MASTER
- Same Vendor_ID can appear multiple times in child tables
- One paper vendor can have 100+ entries in PAPER_PRICING (different sizes, GSM, etc.)
- One printing vendor can have multiple machine configurations in PRINTING_RATES
